target.title: test(qa): migrate channel streaming evidence to transport flow
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `channel-message-flows` QA scenario linked a mock-only Telegram helper test. It claimed primary `channels.streaming` evidence without running a real gateway turn or observing provider-shaped channel requests, and its helper/test pair duplicated behavior already covered by lower-level Telegram tests.

## Why This Change Was Made

This migrates the scenario to one transport-native QA flow:

- `QaTransportAdapter.waitForOutboundSequence` exposes sent/edited/deleted lifecycle events without leaking QA-bus or provider-specific syntax into YAML.
- QA Channel now represents partial replies as editable previews while preserving separate block deliveries, tool-call metadata, and failure cleanup.
- Crabline Telegram normalizes real `sendMessage`, `editMessageText`, and `deleteMessage` recorder traffic and correlates unambiguous preview/final events by message.
- The deterministic mock provider streams preview-only text, then exposes the asserted marker only in the completed final response, so a stalled preview cannot satisfy primary evidence.
- The obsolete 616-line Telegram QA helper/test pair is deleted; focused Telegram draft-stream tests remain in place.
- The repository `channel-message-flows` skill now runs the flow through QA Channel or Crabline Telegram.

No taxonomy entries or coverage IDs are added. The scenario claims primary `channels.streaming` and secondary `runtime.delivery`; the old unproven thread and reasoning secondary claims are removed.

## User Impact

QA maturity evidence for `channels.streaming` now comes from a real gateway turn. The same YAML runs through the synthetic QA Channel for local/UI workflows and through the real Telegram plugin against Crabline for provider-shaped transport proof.

## Evidence

- `OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/providers/mock-openai/server.test.ts extensions/qa-channel/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/qa-transport.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/crabline-transport.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-catalog.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-flow-runner.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-runtime-api.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/suite-runtime-flow.test.ts`
  - 8 files, 182 tests passed before the final matcher guard.
- `OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/qa-transport.test.ts`
  - 3 tests passed after adding the thread-event and final-marker false-positive guards.
- QA Channel scenario:
  - `OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1 node scripts/run-node.mjs qa suite --provider-mode mock-openai --scenario channel-message-flows --concurrency 1 --fast --channel-driver qa-channel --output-dir .artifacts/channel-message-flows-qa`
  - Passed with `sent -> edited -> edited -> edited` and primary `channels.streaming` evidence; the final marker first appears in the completed delivery.
- Crabline Telegram scenario:
  - `OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1 node scripts/run-node.mjs qa suite --provider-mode mock-openai --scenario channel-message-flows --concurrency 1 --fast --channel-driver crabline --channel telegram --output-dir .artifacts/channel-message-flows-crabline`
  - Passed with real Telegram `sendMessage -> editMessageText` traffic and `sent -> edited` evidence.
- `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs run --provider blacksmith-testbox -- env OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed`
  - Passed typecheck, lint, import-cycle, and repository guards on Testbox `tbx_01kwjtmwswjkjzeeqaaewfd561` before the final matcher-only tightening; head CI provides the final broad gate.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output`
  - Clean after the final matcher guards: no accepted/actionable findings; confidence 0.86.
